Where and when to vote on election day:

Precincts 1, 2 & 3: Wilmington Senior Center 130 Main Street

Polls open at 8:00 a.m. and close at 8:00 p.m.

Vote by Mail and Absentee Voting:

 This is a year with a State Primary and State Election.  This means that the Secretary of the Commonwealth election division will be mailing out Vote by Mail post card applications.  If you would like to receive a Vote By Mail Early Ballot or an Absentee ballot, you must apply every year.  Which means that if you applied for one in 2025, you need to apply again in 2026.  Once we receive the ballots we will start mailing them out!  We update this website as we receive new information so check back with us!
